s: March 5, 2025 - The main attraction at Tokyo Skytree is the staggering view from the observation decks. There’s two: the lower deck (Tembo Deck) at 350 meters (1148 ft) and the upper deck (Tembo Galleria) at 450 meters. You can buy tickets just for Tembo Deck or for both decks, depending on your budget.
